question: Why did Richard Ashcroft receive no songwriting royalties from Bitter Sweet Symphony for over twenty years?
answer: Because of borrowed strings. The 1997 hit looped a sample from an orchestral cover of the Rolling Stones' The Last Time. The rights holder argued the band used more than licensed, and the songwriting credit and royalties went to Mick Jagger and Keith Richards. They handed them back to Richard Ashcroft in 2019.
move: Read the licence before building a house on borrowed ground.
